title: Beta-kernel integral representation of G and reduction of C to a Fuchsian connection coefficient
ceiling: Unconditional transcendence of C is NOT a deliverable; a large G_Gal or exponential-period classification does not imply transcendence; only a named-conjecture conditional (or new technology) does.

integral_representation.formula: G(s) = int_0^1 [Phi(z) + 2 z Phi'(z)] dt, z = s t (1-t)

C_reduction.statement: C_EBR = A = K * (4/3) sqrt(pi)/Gamma(7/3); equivalently K = (3/4) C_EBR Gamma(7/3)/sqrt(pi)
C_reduction.K_is: connection coefficient of the FUCHSIAN operator L of Phi between z=0 (exponents {0,0,1,1}) and z=1/3 (exponents {0,1,2,-4/3})
C_reduction.K_numeric_method: series of Phi near z=1/3 (NE=9000 terms), eps in {1e-2,5e-3,2.5e-3}, Richardson exponent 4/3
C_reduction.interpretation: transcendence of C is RELOCATED (not resolved) to the connection coefficient K of a 4th-order Fuchsian operator; the irregular slope-1/4 structure at s=infinity is bypassed for the dominant singularity, since z=s t(1-t) <= s/4 reaches Phi's singularity z=1/3 only at s=R, t=1/2.
C_reduction.grade: STRUCTURAL (exact exponents + saddle) + VERIFIED (integral identity >=100 digits; K consistency low-precision)

deliverable_type: (b) integral/period representation + relocation of the obstruction (Fuchsian K)
obstruction_note: No closed elementary form for K (Phi's z=0->z=1/3 connection coefficient) is produced; this is the precise residual obstruction and the input to cc3-2 (exponential/Fuchsian period interpretation of K) and cc3-3 (named-conjecture conditional). Consistent with the 169-digit elementary nulls.
